content: Instead of adding to the queue or reviewing (for lack of knowlegde) I would like to help finish merging stalled PRs. I see a number of those, where reviewers were fine with the PR but the CI had problems and the submitter gave up. If submitter is no longer around, why not pushing the CI fix as a bystander?
I am guessing that if the submitter gave up but someone else wanted the material, then this already happened.
Yep, I have seen that happen a few times

Kevin Buzzard said:

I am guessing that if the submitter gave up but someone else wanted the material, then this already happened.

I don't want to rule out contributor and reviewer fatigue due to slow review cycles. My vertex set for Digraph PR has been adopted, and the second PR is stuck somewhere in the exchange between author and reviewer
